summary: This resolution recognizes ongoing disparities in mental health access and treatment for Black youth and calls on the current administration to address these issues by continuing previous efforts, implementing recommendations from the "Ring the Alarm" report, increasing mental health funding, and maintaining the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Service Administration (SAMHSA) as an independent agency.

scores.thoughts: This resolution focuses on disparities in Black youth mental health access and treatment, calling for increased funding and continued work to address these issues. This directly relates to the provision and accessibility of healthcare services, specifically mental healthcare.

The resolution calls for increased funding for mental health programs and supports the independence of SAMHSA, which are components of the social safety net aimed at providing support and services to vulnerable populations, in this case, Black youth facing mental health challenges.
